info.title: Parfumée API
info.description: API of the Parfumée shop. `/api/v1/shop` is used by the shop, `/api/v1/admin` by the back-office.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description: A refresh token works once. The response carries a new one, which replaces it.

401.description: The refresh token is missing, unknown, expired or already used

post.description: Any account can sign in; the routes of the back-office then refuse an account without the editor or administrator role.

get.summary: Read my identity and my roles

get.description: Requires the editor role. Every filter is optional.

post.description: Requires the editor role. The slug is computed from the name.

put.description: Requires the editor role. The slug follows the name.

404.description: The product or the category does not exist

post.summary: Add a picture to a product
post.description: Requires the editor role. JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB at most.

get.description: Every filter is optional: without any, the whole catalogue is returned.

error.description: A message written for the client.

field.description: Name of the faulty field, as the client sent it.

token.title: JWT to send in the Authorization header. It lasts 15 minutes.

refresh_token.title: Single-use value to exchange for a new session on /api/v1/token/refresh.

url.title: Path of the file, relative to the uploads directory.

slug.title: URL-safe name, unique in the catalogue.

BadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON, or is not sent as `application/json`

Unauthorized.description: The token is missing, invalid or expired

Forbidden.description: The account does not have the required role

ValidationFailed.description: A field is missing or invalid

Bearer.description: The `token` returned by a sign-in or a token refresh. It lasts 15 minutes.
